seoTitle: How to Recover Your Hostinger Account Without Email
metaDescription: Learn how to recover a Hostinger account when you've lost access to your registered email, including identity verification and contacting support.
intro: Getting locked out of Hostinger because you no longer have access to your registered email is stressful, but there's a defined recovery path you can follow. This guide covers initiating recovery, proving your identity with domain or payment details, and reaching Hostinger support to get back into your account.

steps.heading: Start the account recovery process
steps.body: Look for the account recovery option on the Hostinger login page instead of trying to reset a password you can no longer access.

steps.heading: Verify your identity
steps.body: Provide proof such as domain ownership details or payment history to confirm the account belongs to you.

steps.heading: Contact Hostinger support
steps.body: If self-service recovery doesn't work, reach out to Hostinger's support team directly for manual account restoration.

steps.heading: Update your account email once restored
steps.body: After regaining access, update your registered email immediately so you don't get locked out again in the future.

faq.question: What if I no longer have access to the email on my Hostinger account?
faq.answer: You can still recover the account by verifying your identity through domain or payment proof and contacting support if needed.

faq.question: How long does Hostinger account recovery take?
faq.answer: It depends on how quickly you can provide verification details, but working directly with support tends to speed things up.

faq.question: What proof does Hostinger accept for identity verification?
faq.answer: Details like domain ownership or past payment information are commonly used to confirm the account is yours.

faq.question: Should I update my email after recovering my account?
faq.answer: Yes, updating to an email you can reliably access helps prevent this issue from happening again.
